comments: Child corrects their own color identification from green to red.
The child corrects the previous turn's negation by asserting ownership ('No, this is father's'), which is a factual correction.
Child refuses mother's offer to fix the watch ('bōʔi nesadēr laḳ') in line 9354.
Child states that nothing is written in the picture in response to 'ma katuv batmuna ?', indicating the absence of text.
The child is making a factual statement about the object's identity/shape ('this is not cubes'), correcting the context of the discussion about rolling.
Child negates the mother's claim that the ear is wet; mother's response 'it dried' (hityabēš) indicates the wetness is gone.
Child asserts ownership ('this is mine') to reject the interviewer's handling of the ball, confirmed by the adult's response 'this is yours' (line 32792).
Child asks if the object doesn't pinch them after being closed; this is a factual question about a property.
Child questions the identity of the object ('Is this not an album?'), which is a factual query answered by the mother in line 40538.
The child uses a negative imperative 'don't take' to resist the mother's request to give the item to Asaf (lines 41688, 41692).
Child denies that the adult took the object, confirmed by adult's response 'I made a mistake' (line 92751).
Child uses negative imperative 'al tiqxī' to block someone from taking her horse.
Child responds to 'What do you want?' by rejecting the implied shift in topic and demanding to see the candle.
Child states the candle/fire is finished/gone, indicating absence.
The child denies the mother's claim in line 110082 that Miryam can do what she wants, asserting instead that Miryam wants to close the item.
Child rejects the proposal to tell more to the tape (line 110728), proposing instead to talk when mother arrives.
Child refuses mother's proposal to tell a story about Kruvi (line 110821).
Child says 'no no' following mother's directive to 'leave it' (taʕazvī) and her comments on the TV; functions as a rejection of the mother's instruction/stance.
Child expresses a refusal or lack of desire for the 'rabbit cake' mentioned in the context of the album.
Child refuses the 'rabbits' in the context of a discussion about which toys to bring or use.
Child rejects mother's offer to take the baby/doll (line 116335).
Child refuses mother's directive to put the item in the bin (line 117070).
Child denies the mother's characterization of her as a 'naughty girl' (yaldā šovavā) in lines 117085 and 117088.
Child rejects the item after being told by father and doctor that it is forbidden.
Child refuses the interviewer's proposal to go to sleep (line 129053).
Child refuses the proposal to go home (line 129095).
Child states that the mother is not helping; mother's subsequent 'loʔ' (line 173162) confirms this is a factual dispute.
Child rejects mother's suggestion to tell a story about 'the mess of Ariq' (line 194985).
Child is narrating a story and reports that the pacifier was not found; this is a factual statement about a failed action.

The phrase 'Bli Sodot' (Without Secrets) is the name of a show or book, as confirmed by the mother's follow-up question 'ma hayā ba# Bli Sodōt ?' (line 195228). It is not functioning as a negation act.
Child answers 'I don't know' to Mother's question 'Where?' (line 196038) regarding a missing piece.
Child refuses the book offered in line 229700.
Child uses negative imperative 'al' to stop the father from saying a specific word, repeating a previous command from line 243030.
Child corrects the adult's understanding of where something was taken ('you didn't take [it] here').
Child is identifying objects, stating that one is a disc and the other is not, as a factual correction/clarification of the adult's identification in line 271658.
Child states that there is nothing today ('ʔeyn klum'), expressing nonexistence.
Child corrects the adult's identification of the object as an album, later specifying it is a book (line 272417).
Child is identifying pictures; after calling one 'mother', the child says 'this is not', correcting the factual identification.
Child asserts they opened the object, contradicting previous inability ('lo yaxol') and celebrating success after adult's encouragement.
Child is playing doctor and asserts that the action does not hurt.
The token 'af' here means 'nose' (body part), not a negation.
Child corrects the color of the balloon from blue to yellow after mother's disagreement in line 285012.
